services.title: Next.js Architecture
services.description: We build SEO-friendly, ultra-fast, and scalable modern web applications with App Router, React 19, Server Components, and Streaming.

services.title: Cloudflare Edge & Security
services.description: We build edge-first infrastructures that load in milliseconds worldwide and are protected against DDoS and bot attacks through Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and WAF integration.

services.title: E-Commerce Solutions
services.description: We integrate Shopify, Medusa, and custom payment gateways through headless e-commerce architecture, delivering high-conversion sales platforms with optimized checkout flows.

services.title: Performance & SEO Optimization
services.description: We deliver technical SEO infrastructure with 100% PageSpeed scores, Zero-CLS, Core Web Vitals compliance, and structured data (Schema.org) to rank at the top of search engines.

services.title: SaaS Dashboard Development
services.description: We develop complex data visualization, real-time updates, and user-friendly management panels for B2B SaaS products.

services.title: Headless CMS Integration
services.description: We build modern content management infrastructures with Sanity.io and Payload CMS that your content team can easily manage and developers can flexibly integrate.

services.title: API Development & Integration
services.description: We develop RESTful and GraphQL APIs and securely integrate third-party services like payment systems, shipping companies, and CRM software into your projects.

services.title: Database & Backend Architecture
services.description: We design type-safe, performant, and maintainable database architectures with PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM to manage your data securely and efficiently.

kar-dedektoru.title: Kâr Dedektörü
kar-dedektoru.subtitle: Profitability Analytics Platform for Marketplace Sellers
kar-dedektoru.description: An AI-assisted profitability analytics platform that reveals commissions, shipping fees and service costs for Trendyol and Hepsiburada sellers.
kar-dedektoru.longDescription: Kâr Dedektörü is a SaaS platform we are building to expose the hidden gap between gross revenue and true net profit for marketplace sellers. It calculates commission rates, variable shipping tariffs, service fees and VAT deductions on a per-order basis to provide product-level profitability visibility. The platform is currently in closed beta.

entegrematik.title: Entegrematik
entegrematik.subtitle: Multi-Marketplace Integration & Operations Platform
entegrematik.description: A multi-marketplace integration platform that manages product listing, orders and invoicing from a single panel.
entegrematik.longDescription: Entegrematik enables e-commerce sellers to manage products, orders and invoices across multiple marketplaces from a single screen. Its control panel summarizes daily revenue, pending orders and integration health to reduce operational load. The next-generation interface is currently in development.
features: Order management from a single panel

technova.title: TechNova SaaS Platform
technova.subtitle: Edge-First B2B SaaS Architecture Showcase
technova.description: A technical demo showcasing edge-first architecture for high-traffic B2B SaaS scenarios.
technova.longDescription: TechNova is a demo project built to demonstrate the limits of edge-first architecture in high-traffic B2B SaaS scenarios; there is no real client engagement. It showcases real-time data synchronization, multi-tenant structure and edge-cached API responses using Next.js 15 App Router and Cloudflare Workers.

luxecommerce.title: LuxeCommerce E-Commerce
luxecommerce.subtitle: Headless Storefront Demo Study
luxecommerce.description: A demo storefront presenting headless commerce flows (catalog, cart, checkout) end to end.
luxecommerce.longDescription: LuxeCommerce is a demo storefront study presenting headless commerce flows end to end; there is no real client engagement. Catalog, cart and checkout flows are optimized with Next.js 15 static export, and the payment layer is modeled on a Stripe-like sandbox.

finedge.title: FinEdge Dashboard
finedge.subtitle: Real-Time Data Visualization R&D
finedge.description: An R&D dashboard exploring real-time financial data visualization techniques.
finedge.longDescription: FinEdge is an R&D study exploring real-time financial data visualization techniques. WebSocket-based data streams, edge-cached charts and the impact of high-frequency updates on Core Web Vitals were measured in this project.

greenenergy.title: GreenEnergy Corporate
greenenergy.subtitle: Corporate Architecture & Technical SEO Showcase
greenenergy.description: A demo showcasing corporate site architecture and technical SEO practices (static export, Zero-CLS).
greenenergy.longDescription: GreenEnergy is a demo project built to showcase corporate website architecture and technical SEO practices (static export, Zero-CLS, structured data); there is no real client engagement.

edgeperf-lab.title: EdgePerf Lab
edgeperf-lab.subtitle: Internal Core Web Vitals Optimization Laboratory
edgeperf-lab.description: Our internal performance laboratory where we develop Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse optimization techniques.
edgeperf-lab.longDescription: EdgePerf Lab is an ongoing R&D initiative within our agency. We test and measure techniques for improving LCP, CLS and INP metrics (critical CSS, font loading strategies, image prioritization, edge caching) in this laboratory. The 100/100 Lighthouse scores on this website are a direct result of this work.
features: Critical CSS and font loading strategies

luxe-marketplace-ui.title: Luxe Marketplace UI
luxe-marketplace-ui.subtitle: Premium E-Commerce UI/UX Concept Study
luxe-marketplace-ui.description: A dark-mode UI/UX concept study designed for premium e-commerce experiences.
luxe-marketplace-ui.longDescription: Luxe Marketplace UI is a UI/UX concept study produced purely for research and design exploration, without any client scope. Glassmorphic surfaces, neon accents and mobile-first component systems were prototyped in this study.

about_page.pageDescription: Endijital's story, our mission, and our digital transformation vision.

story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Endijital was founded in 2024 with our passion for Next.js and modern web technologies. Our goal was to build digital products that would help businesses reach their true potential by questioning traditional web development approaches.

When we discovered Cloudflare Edge infrastructure, we saw that the future of the web lies in edge-first architecture. Websites that load in milliseconds anywhere in the world, are secure and scalable, have become not just an option, but a necessity.

Today, with our team equipped with Next.js 15, React 19, and Cloudflare technologies, we accompany businesses on their digital transformation journey. In every project, we focus on long-term success by prioritizing performance, security, and user experience.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To help businesses gain competitive advantages in the digital world with modern web technologies. To contribute to our clients' growth by building performance-focused, scalable, and secure digital products.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To become Turkey's leading edge-first web development agency. To shape the future of the web by playing a pioneering role in the Next.js and Cloudflare ecosystem.
